The Dizzy Story
Every great story begins in a place that shapes the soul. For Carlos English... that place was Detroit, Michigan.
detroit
Born in Detroit
Born on November the twentieth, nineteen eighty-four, on the east side of Detroit. A city that doesn't just test you... it forges you. The courts were his classroom. The streets, his proving ground. Detroit doesn't build basketball players. It builds warriors.
fitzgerald
Warren Fitzgerald High School
At Warren Fitzgerald High School, Carlos became a four-year varsity starter. Standing five foot nine, coaches told him he was too small. But the boy from Detroit had something measurements couldn't capture... heart. He was ranked the sixth best point guard in all of Michigan. AP Class B All-State Second Team.
grind
The Grind
From Fitzgerald to Mott Community College in Flint. Then Cleveland State University, Division One. Career high eighteen points against Wright State. Twelve assists against Michigan State. Then the D-League — Dakota Wizards, Fort Wayne Mad Ants. Most would have quit. Carlos kept working.
globetrotters
Harlem Globetrotters — #2 Dizzy
And then... the call that changed everything. The Harlem Globetrotters. Carlos English became Dizzy English, number two. For eleven years, he traveled the world. Performing in sold-out arenas on every continent. Entertaining millions with his intricate ball spins, his legendary slide dribbles, and a showmanship that could only come from a man who had spent his whole life proving the doubters wrong.
highlights
The Signature Moves
Ball spins that defied physics. Slide dribbles across the full court that left audiences gasping. The four-point shot that brought arenas to their feet. Featured on NPR. Captured in over three hundred and fifty professional photographs. His number two jersey still hangs in the Globetrotters store today.
transition
The New Chapter
In twenty twenty-one, after eleven years with the Globetrotters, Carlos retired. But legends don't fade. They transform. He moved to Nashville, Tennessee, and began the most important chapter of his life... building the next generation.
today
Building the Next Generation
Today, Carlos English is a teacher and assistant coach at Christ Presbyterian Academy. He founded Carlos English Basketball LLC. He directs the Carlos English Elite AAU program... ranked number thirty-six in the entire nation. He is a motivational speaker. A brand owner. A father. A husband. A man of faith and purpose.
legacy
Heart Has No Height Requirement
From the streets of Detroit to stadiums around the world. And back to the gym where it all began. Carlos Dizzy English is living proof... that heart doesn't have a height requirement. They told him he was too small. He told them to watch him work. And the world watched.
close
This has been a Heaven's Dynasty presentation. The journey of Carlos Dizzy English. The story continues.
